sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, ch.c1Sku AS child1Sku, ch.c1Name AS child1Name, ch.c1BundleQty AS child1BundleQty, ch.c1StockOption AS child1StockOption, ch.c1StoreQty AS child1StoreQty, ch.c1LeadTime AS child1LeadTime, ch.c1State AS child1State, ch.c2Sku AS child2Sku, ch.c2Name AS child2Name, ch.c2BundleQty AS child2BundleQty, ch.c2StockOption AS child2StockOption, ch.c2StoreQty AS child2StoreQty, ch.c2LeadTime AS child2LeadTime, ch.c2State AS child2State, ch.c3Sku AS child3Sku, ch.c3Name AS child3Name, ch.c3BundleQty AS child3BundleQty, ch.c3StockOption AS child3StockOption, ch.c3StoreQty AS child3StoreQty, ch.c3LeadTime AS child3LeadTime, ch.c3State AS child3State, po.InStockMsg AS inStockMessage, po.OutOfStockMsg AS outOfStockMessage FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store CROSS APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.SKU END) AS c1Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.ProductName END) AS c1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.bq END) AS c1BundleQty, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.oo END) AS c1StockOption, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.qty END) AS c1StoreQty, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.lead END) AS c1LeadTime, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n1 THEN k.st END) AS c1State, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.SKU END) AS c2Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.ProductName END) AS c2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.bq END) AS c2BundleQty, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.oo END) AS c2StockOption, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.qty END) AS c2StoreQty, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.lead END) AS c2LeadTime, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n2 THEN k.st END) AS c2State, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.SKU END) AS c3Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.ProductName END) AS c3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.bq END) AS c3BundleQty, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.oo END) AS c3StockOption, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.qty END) AS c3StoreQty, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.lead END) AS c3LeadTime, MAX(CASE WHEN k.rn = @n3 THEN k.st END) AS c3State FROM (SELECT c.SKU, c.ProductName, a.BundleQuantity AS bq, c.OutOfStockOptions AS oo, CAST(ISNULL(sq.qty, @none) AS BIGINT) AS qty, lt.v AS lead, CASE WHEN c.OutOfStockOptions IN (@backOrderOption, @dontTrackOption) THEN @untrackedState WHEN ISNULL(sq.qty, @none) >= a.BundleQuantity THEN @trackedState ELSE @outOfStockState END AS st, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.DisplayOrder, c.PimProductId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(si.Quantity) AS qty FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory si INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse spw ON spw.PortalId = po.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalAlternateWarehouse saw ON saw.PortalWarehouseId = spw.PortalWarehouseId AND saw.WarehouseId = si.WarehouseId WHERE si.SKU = c.SKU AND (si.WarehouseId = spw.WarehouseId OR saw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NOT NULL)) sq OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 lv.AttributeValue AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ta ON ta.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale lv ON lv.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId AND lv.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE av.PimProductId = c.PimProductId AND ta.AttributeCode = @leadTimeCode ORDER BY av.PimAttributeValueId) lt WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive) k) ch WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) AND (@child1State IS NULL OR ch.c1State = @child1State OR (@child1State = @availableState AND ch.c1State <> @outOfStockState)) AND (@child2State IS NULL OR ch.c2State = @child2State OR (@child2State = @availableState AND ch.c2State <> @outOfStockState)) AND (@child3State IS NULL OR ch.c3State = @child3State OR (@child3State = @availableState AND ch.c3State <> @outOfStockState)) AND (@leadTimeChild IS NULL OR (@leadTimeChild = @n1 AND ch.c1LeadTime IS NOT NULL) OR (@leadTimeChild = @n2 AND ch.c2LeadTime IS NOT NULL) OR (@leadTimeChild = @n3 AND ch.c3LeadTime IS NOT NULL)) AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @publishSuccess AND pe.IsActive = @storefrontActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @storefrontObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @none ORDER BY p.SKU
